description: This file contains test cases using Vitest for functions related to connection hints and authentication hints in a UI context, specifically testing 'shouldShowPairingHint' and 'resolveAuthHintKind' functions.

methods.name: shouldShowPairingHint
methods.description: Determines whether the pairing hint should be shown based on connection status, error message, and error code.

methods.name: resolveAuthHintKind
methods.description: Resolves the type of authentication hint ('required', 'failed', or null) based on connection error details.
